<resources xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools"> <!-- Base application theme. --> <style name="Theme.Castafiore" parent="Theme.MaterialComponents.NoActionBar"> <!-- Primary brand color. --> <item name="colorPrimary">@color/primary</item> <item name="colorPrimaryVariant">@color/primary_dark</item> <item name="colorOnPrimary">@color/text_on_primary</item> <!-- Secondary brand color. --> <item name="colorSecondary">@color/secondary</item> <item name="colorSecondaryVariant">@color/secondary_dark</item> <item name="colorOnSecondary">@color/text_on_primary</item> <!-- Status bar color. --> <item name="android:statusBarColor">@color/background_primary</item> <!-- Customize your theme here. --> <!-- Colores de superficie y fondo --> <item name="android:colorBackground">@color/background_primary</item> <item name="colorSurface">@color/surface</item> <item name="colorOnSurface">@color/text_primary</item> <item name="colorSurfaceVariant">@color/surface_variant</item> <item name="colorOnSurfaceVariant">@color/text_secondary</item>
<!-- Colores de error --> <item name="colorError">@color/error</item> <item name="colorOnError">@color/white</item>
<!-- Fondo de ventana --> <item name="android:windowBackground">@color/background_primary</item>
<!-- Colores de texto --> <item name="android:textColorPrimary">@color/text_primary</item> <item name="android:textColorSecondary">@color/text_secondary</item>
<!-- Barra de estado y navegación --> <item name="android:statusBarColor">@color/background_primary</item> <item name="android:navigationBarColor">@color/background_primary</item> <item name="android:windowLightStatusBar">false</item> <item name="android:windowLightNavigationBar">false</item>
<!-- Forzar tema oscuro siempre --> <item name="android:forceDarkAllowed" tools:targetApi="q">false</item>
<!-- Contenedores --> <item name="colorPrimaryContainer">@color/surface</item> <item name="colorOnPrimaryContainer">@color/text_primary</item> <item name="colorSecondaryContainer">@color/surface_variant</item> <item name="colorOnSecondaryContainer">@color/text_primary</item>
<!-- Outline --> <item name="colorOutline">@color/outline</item>
<!-- Control destacado --> <item name="colorControlHighlight">@color/primary_light</item> <item name="colorControlActivated">@color/primary</item> <item name="colorControlNormal">@color/text_secondary</item> </style> </resources>

<resources xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools"> <!-- Tema nocturno - Modo oscuro con color principal #FF2D55 --> <style name="Theme.Castafiore" parent="Theme.MaterialComponents.DayNight.NoActionBar"> <!-- Colores primarios --> <item name="colorPrimary">@color/primary</item> <item name="colorPrimaryVariant">@color/primary_dark</item> <item name="colorOnPrimary">@color/text_on_primary</item>
<!-- Colores secundarios --> <item name="colorSecondary">@color/secondary</item> <item name="colorSecondaryVariant">@color/secondary_dark</item> <item name="colorOnSecondary">@color/text_on_primary</item>
<!-- Colores de superficie y fondo para modo oscuro --> <item name="android:colorBackground">@color/background_dark</item> <item name="colorSurface">@color/surface_dark</item> <item name="colorOnSurface">@color/text_on_dark</item> <item name="colorSurfaceVariant">@color/surface_variant_dark</item> <item name="colorOnSurfaceVariant">@color/text_secondary_dark</item>
<!-- Colores de error --> <item name="colorError">@color/error</item> <item name="colorOnError">@color/white</item>
<!-- Fondo de ventana --> <item name="android:windowBackground">@color/background_dark</item>
<!-- Colores de texto para modo oscuro --> <item name="android:textColorPrimary">@color/text_on_dark</item> <item name="android:textColorSecondary">@color/text_secondary_dark</item>
<!-- Barra de estado y navegación para modo oscuro --> <item name="android:statusBarColor">@color/background_dark</item> <item name="android:navigationBarColor">@color/background_dark</item> <item name="android:windowLightStatusBar">false</item> <item name="android:windowLightNavigationBar">false</item>
<!-- Contenedores --> <item name="colorPrimaryContainer">@color/surface_dark</item> <item name="colorOnPrimaryContainer">@color/text_on_dark</item> <item name="colorSecondaryContainer">@color/surface_variant_dark</item> <item name="colorOnSecondaryContainer">@color/text_on_dark</item>
<!-- Outline --> <item name="colorOutline">@color/outline_dark</item>
<!-- Control destacado --> <item name="colorControlHighlight">@color/primary_alpha_12</item> <item name="colorControlActivated">@color/primary</item> <item name="colorControlNormal">@color/text_secondary_dark</item>
<!-- Ripple effect --> <item name="android:colorControlHighlight">@color/ripple</item> </style> </resources>
